title: Privacy Policy
subtitle: Applies to the DJ ELECTRONICS website and the BMS Protection Board Manager mobile app, including versions published on Google Play and Apple App Store.
updated: Last Updated: July 25, 2026 | Effective Date: July 25, 2026

sections.title: 1. Core Principle
sections.text: BMS Protection Board Manager is a professional local debugging tool for BMS protection boards. The app is designed for local operation, local device connection, and local storage. It does not require account registration, does not actively collect personally identifiable information, does not automatically upload user data to servers, and is not used for advertising, user tracking, cross-app tracking, or user profiling.

sections.title: 2. Personal Information Collection
sections.text: The app does not actively collect, store, or upload the user's name, phone number, email address, contacts, SMS, call logs, photos, camera content, account information, advertising identifiers, precise location, or background location data. Tracking, privacy collection, and data sharing items that Apple reviews closely are not functional purposes of this app.

sections.title: 3. Data Processed Locally
sections.text: To connect BMS devices, display data, and configure parameters, the app may process BMS device operating data locally on the user's device, such as voltage, current, temperature, protection thresholds, balancing status, and fault status; configuration data saved by the user; and local operation logs for troubleshooting. Unless the user actively exports, screenshots, copies, or sends such data to us for support, we do not access this local data.

sections.title: 4. Permission Usage
sections.text: Bluetooth permissions are used only to scan, pair, connect, and communicate with BMS protection boards. On Android 11 and earlier, location permission may be required by the system as a prerequisite for BLE scanning; this permission is used only to scan for and connect nearby BMS devices, and the app does not obtain, record, store, or upload the user's actual geographic location. On Android 12 and later, the app prioritizes the system's dedicated Bluetooth permissions. On iOS, Bluetooth permission is used only to discover, connect, and communicate with BMS devices, and not for location, advertising, tracking, or analytics. If USB or serial permissions are supported, they are used only for local device communication.

sections.title: 5. Purpose of Data Use
sections.text: Local data is used only to scan and connect BMS devices, display real-time battery and BMS status, read or configure BMS parameters, save local configurations selected by the user, improve communication stability, and support local debugging. The app does not use this data for advertising, commercial analytics, data sales, third-party sharing, or purposes unrelated to BMS management.

sections.title: 6. Storage, Deletion, and Security
sections.text: Operation data, configuration data, and logs are stored locally on the user's device by default and are protected by the operating system sandbox. Users can clear local data in the app or through system settings. When the app is uninstalled, the operating system usually removes app cache and local configurations. If the user actively exports or shares local files, those files are managed by the user.

sections.title: 7. Third-Party SDKs and Data Sharing
sections.text: The current version does not integrate advertising, analytics, tracking, payment, map, cloud storage, or user analysis SDKs. We do not sell, rent, or share users' personal information or local BMS device data with third parties. If a future version integrates third-party services or changes data processing practices, we will update this policy before use and obtain necessary authorization according to platform rules.

sections.title: 8. Children and Minors
sections.text: The app is a professional tool for BMS protection board development, debugging, maintenance, and industrial use. It is not directed to children. We do not knowingly collect children's personal information. Minors should not use the app independently; if use is necessary, it should be supervised by a guardian or professional.

sections.title: 9. User Rights
sections.text: Users may view, modify, export, or delete available local configuration data in the app, or stop using and uninstall the app. Because the app does not require account registration and does not automatically upload user data, we usually cannot identify, access, or delete local data stored on the user's device from a server side.

sections.title: 10. Policy Updates
sections.text: We may update this Privacy Policy due to app function changes, platform policy changes, or legal requirements. The updated version will be published on the company website or the public privacy policy page used for app store listings. Continued use of the app means you understand the updated content.
